summary: Verified the per-lesson recording_url feature end-to-end for Live Group Trainings, plus the Home hero pill/section and the redesigned /canli-grup-egitimleri list. Backend pytest 5/5 pass in /app/backend/tests/test_recording_url.py: (1) GET /api/group-trainings/google-ads-canli-grup-egitimi (public) exposes lessons with ONLY {id,title,date,time} — no recording_url and no meet_link keys, verified via key-set check; (2) same guarantee holds for the public listing /api/group-trainings; (3) admin GET /api/admin/group-trainings returns both meet_link and recording_url per lesson and the seed lesson 1 has recording_url=https://vimeo.com/76979871 while lesson 2 has empty; (4) admin POST + PUT persist recording_url per lesson (POST creates a training with per-lesson recording_url, PUT updates lesson 2, admin GET reflects change, public detail STILL hides both keys) — created training deleted at teardown; (5) fresh enrolled student (register + direct db.group_enrollments insert) hitting GET /api/my/group-trainings receives lessons that include recording_url and meet_link and sees the seeded vimeo url on lesson 1, empty on lesson 2 — enrollment and user cleaned up. Frontend Playwright: /canli-grup-egitimleri renders the premium hero with 'CANLI EĞİTİMLER' badge + 'Google Meet' chip and the GroupCard grid; clicking group-card-google-ads-canli-grup-egitimi navigates to the detail page (group-buy visible, price 4.999₺, Kalan Yer 12). Home (/) shows the hero-group-cta pill (href=/canli-grup-egitimleri), the home-group-section, home-all-groups button and group-card-google-ads-canli-grup-egitimi. Admin /yonetim/grup-egitimleri → edit seed training loads lesson-recording-0 with 'https://vimeo.com/76979871', lesson-recording-1 empty, and lesson-meet-0 present; changing lesson-recording-1 to https://vimeo.com/999999999 and clicking save-group shows the 'Kaydedildi' toast, reopening the edit dialog shows the persisted value (lesson 1 unchanged); restored lesson 2 back to empty at cleanup. Student panel (logged in as a temporary TEST_uirec_* enrolled student) tab-group shows the seed training with recording-link-<gl_id> button labeled 'Kaydı İzle' (href=https://vimeo.com/76979871) on lesson 1 and 'Link yakında eklenecek' fallback text on lesson 2 (which has neither meet nor recording). Cleanup done: 1 group_enrollment + 1 users record removed; seed lessons back to [('Hesap Kurulumu & Strateji', 'https://vimeo.com/76979871', ''), ('Kampanya Optimizasyonu', '', '')].
critical_code_review_comments: routes_group._public() destructures with_links into a dict-spread; if with_links=True and a lesson stored in DB somehow lacks 'recording_url' or 'meet_link' keys (e.g., legacy docs), .get('...','') coerces to '' — good defensive behavior. No change needed.

AdminGroupTrainings.jsx sends the full form on PUT including all lessons; there's no partial patch. If two admins edit concurrently, last-write-wins overwrites the other's recording_url — acceptable for admin usage but worth documenting.

GroupPanel isPast() compares to client-local Date; users in different timezones may see 'Kaydı İzle' rendering as expected but the past/disabled state on Meet button relies on client clock. Consider passing lesson_start_utc or including a server 'now' hint for consistency. Non-blocking.

The public GroupCard uses <a> tag via Link wrapping the full card; inside, there are no nested <a>s here — clean. The Meet cdn URL 'https://cdn.simpleicons.org/googlemeet' is external; loading it lazily or inlining an SVG would remove third-party dependency on the list page.

Consider guarding /my/group-trainings response so that lessons without a recording still return recording_url:'' (already covered by _norm_lessons for admin-created docs). Seed docs already have the field.

success_rate.backend: 100% (5/5 new; existing test_group_trainings.py and test_social_and_group_extras.py untouched and still applicable)

seed_data_creation: Temporarily set seed lesson 2 recording_url to https://vimeo.com/999999999 to prove persistence, then restored to '' via UI save. Registered a temp student TEST_uirec_228d99@example.com and inserted one group_enrollment for the seed training to verify recording_url exposure on /my/group-trainings and the 'Kaydı İzle' button; both the enrollment and the user row have been deleted. Backend test_admin_create_update_persists_recording_url creates & deletes its own 'TEST Recording' training. No leftover test data. Seed lesson 1 recording_url confirmed back to https://vimeo.com/76979871.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New backend suite: /app/backend/tests/test_recording_url.py — covers public/list/admin/enrolled-student visibility of recording_url plus create/update persistence. Requires MONGO_URL/DB_NAME env vars (strip quotes from backend/.env) for the enrolled-student test; the other 4 need only REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Frontend testids in use for this feature: lesson-recording-<i> and lesson-meet-<i> (Admin edit form), save-group, edit-group-<group_id>, admin-group-<group_id>; recording-link-<lesson_id> and meet-link-<lesson_id> (student GroupPanel); hero-group-cta, home-group-section, home-all-groups, group-card-<slug> (Home + List). PayTR remains unconfigured => 503 on purchase.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature verification pass, no bugs found.
